title: Host container gets the Docker socket
reason: The container that runs the host-side MCP tools has the Docker socket, so any code execution or file-write bug in those tools becomes root on the Docker host.
fix: Run sandbox containers through a restricted Docker API proxy (allow only create/start/stop of the sandbox image) instead of mounting the raw socket.

title: Web UI listens on 0.0.0.0 with no authentication in the Docker image
reason: The Gradio UI is published on port 7861 on all interfaces without auth, so anyone who can reach it can drive the agent (spending the operator's API keys) and download workspace files.
fix: Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default and pass auth=(user, password) or put it behind an authenticating proxy.
